reportSubtitle: Slow Week, Busy Season Competition Heating Up
summary:
Tough week on conversions — 1 booking at $320.50 vs 5 at $56 last week. Traffic quality is still solid (clean search terms, stable CTR) so this looks like small-sample variance rather than a real problem.

The bigger story: four new local competitors entered the Google Ads auction this week — Velvet Alchemy, Bad Rabbit Caravan, CaterCow, and The Next Course. Event season is ramping up in Denver, which pushed CPC up 17% from $6.52 to $7.63. Thumbtack remains the top competitor with nearly identical impression share. MCB is holding position well — 82% top of page — but the auction is getting more expensive.

metrics.label: Conversions
metrics.note: Down from 5 last week. Likely variance — traffic quality is unchanged.

metrics.label: Ad Spend
metrics.note: Up from $281 last week. Still budget-limited at $40/day.

metrics.label: Avg CPC
metrics.note: Up 17% from $6.52. More competitors in the auction as event season ramps up.

metrics.label: CTR
metrics.note: Stable — ad relevance holding up despite more competition.

funnel.title: Ad-to-Booking Funnel
funnel.notes: Search terms are clean — zero spam. 'Bartenders for hire' still drives 97% of spend.

charts.title: CPC Trend — Event Season Is Driving Up Costs

findings.title: Event Season Competition Is Here
findings.description: Four new local competitors entered the auction: Velvet Alchemy Mobile Spirits, Bad Rabbit Caravan, CaterCow, and The Next Course Co. Previous competitors Barmasters and Moderncate have dropped off. CPC jumped 17% ($6.52 → $7.63) as more Denver mobile bar companies turn on Google Ads for event season.

findings.title: Thumbtack Is Still the Top Competitor
findings.description: Nearly identical impression share (16.2% vs 15.8%) and they beat MCB on position about half the time. MCB is holding its own with 82% top of page rate — strong positioning despite the increased competition.

actions.title: Reviewed Search Terms
actions.description: All visible search terms are relevant — event bartending, hire a bartender, denver wedding catering, wedding bar cart. Zero spam. A few competitor brand searches (tap truck denver, the one mobile bar) showing buyer intent.

actions.title: Analyzed Auction Insights for New Competitors
actions.description: Identified 4 new local competitors entering the auction. CPC increase correlates with the busier auction. This is seasonal — expect it to continue through summer.

nextSteps: Monitor whether conversion volume recovers next week — one bad week isn't a trend.
Track CPC trajectory as event season continues. If it keeps climbing, discuss budget increase to maintain impression share.
